Description.value: Cuts the cost of RegionFileManager.CullExpiredChunks: a faster scan loop (HashSet instead of List.Contains, no repeated dictionary lookups) and a minimum interval between sweeps. Semantics are unchanged. Only does work on a server with MaxChunkAge enabled or chunk resets pending, so it belongs next to MaxChunkAgeDeadlockFix. Config.xml is hot-reloaded. Console: cullfix status|reset|interval|throttle|fastscan|log|run|stuck|save|reload. Built for game version 2.6.
